text: Debugging is an important skill for any programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem comes from and understand why it happens. There are many debugging tools that can help you, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution. However, a good systematic approach matters even more. Instead of guessing, you should test your code carefully and check one part at a time. Another useful method is logging. By adding print statements or log messages, you can see what your program is doing and spot the exact moment things go wrong.
